title: Vercel case study
description: A customer story on a 12-column grid: a big tight heading above a wide 8-column screenshot window, with a narrow 3-column text column beside it holding a two-tone statement (the claim in ink, the rest in grey) and a short list of feature links under a small grey label. The window can stand alone or sit in front of a second window peeking out behind-left; both fade into the page at the bottom. Mirror it with align to alternate stories.
notes: align start puts the window left and the text right; end mirrors it (heading moves over the window)
phones always stack heading, window(s), statement, features
media slots: front window (and an optional back window); empty, they are ringed grey windows
no motion of its own (the original's motion is inside its screenshots)
